title: Macroeconomic Reform Cycle v6 — Ultimate Fix (Physical Water Source + M0 Preservation)
description: Sixth revision. Fixes 2 critical rejection issues: (1) Utilities — off-grid buildings must have a physical local water source (WaterWell with CAPEX, maintenance, aquifer-limited yield) before outputting sewage (no 'water from air'); (2) Cooperatives — emigration must CREDIT domestic currency to central bank's domestic ledger (M0 preserved, not deleted) while DEBITING forex_reserve (capital flight). 7 blueprints, 3 parallel tracks.

blueprints.rationale: No content changes from v5. Import logistics with FreightCapacity costing via B2B trade.
No content changes from v5. C2G fee routing via state/tax.rs. Provides LocalPollutionState that blueprint-006 off-grid waste outputs into.
No content changes from v5. MoD pays all FreightCapacity and StorageCapacity.
No content changes from v5. Manager confirmed municipal budget financing is approved as-is.
No content changes from v5. Housing split 1/3.

v6 fix: Off-grid buildings now require a physical WaterWell (CAPEX, maintenance, aquifer-limited yield, complete lifecycle) before outputting sewage. sewage_volume = MIN(water_extracted_from_well, consumption_demand). No well = no water = no sewage. Water comes from the ground (aquifer), not thin air. Added utilities/hydro_grid.rs to scope.

v6 fix: Emigration now CREDITS domestic currency to central bank's domestic ledger (M0 preserved, not deleted). Three-step flow: (1) DEBIT citizen, (2) CREDIT central bank domestic ledger, (3) DEBIT fx_reserves. The v5 design incorrectly deleted the domestic currency (deflationary black hole). Central bank can later re-inject via OMO.

rejection_fixes_applied_v6.blueprint-006_utilities: PHYSICAL WATER SOURCE FIX: Off-grid buildings now require a deep WaterWell with CAPEX (Steel, Concrete, machinery scaled by well_depth), maintenance OPEX (scaled by water_volume_extracted), aquifer-limited yield (hard limit with depletion, linked to geography.rs), and complete lifecycle (construction, operation, depletion, abandonment). sewage_volume = MIN(water_extracted_from_well, consumption_demand). No well = no water = no sewage. Water physically comes from the ground (aquifer), is consumed by residents, and exits as sewage/pollution. Connected buildings use municipal water grid instead. Added utilities/hydro_grid.rs to scope.
rejection_fixes_applied_v6.blueprint-007_cooperatives: M0 BLACK HOLE FIX: The domestic currency debited from the emigrating citizen is now CREDITED to the central bank's domestic ledger (liquidity_injected or equivalent) — NOT deleted. The central bank 'buys back' its own currency using forex reserves. M0 is fully preserved: money moves from citizen → central bank domestic ledger. The central bank can later re-inject this via OMO or lending. Three-step flow: (1) DEBIT citizen, (2) CREDIT central bank domestic ledger, (3) DEBIT fx_reserves. The v5 design incorrectly deleted the domestic currency (deflationary black hole).

mitigation_strategy: Three parallel tracks with sequential deployment. v6 adds utilities/hydro_grid.rs to blueprint-006 scope only (Track C) — no cross-track conflict. environment/smog.rs shared between Environment (002, Track B) and Utilities (006, Track C) — different tracks, Iron CI/CD integration boundary handles merge conflicts. Utilities only adds off_grid_waste_emission function, does not modify existing LocalPollutionState struct. state/central_bank.rs and state/forex.rs only used by Cooperatives (007, Track C) — no conflict.
